title: Four ways to see the bayou. Pick yours.
why: Warm leads deciding between tours and rentals; matches each option to a type of guest with real prices from the vault and real review proof, ending on the fall moon paddle.
hook_options: Four ways to see the bayou. Pick yours.
Skyline, bats, full moon, or no guide at all?
Which bayou paddle fits your group
caption: First time? Houston Skyline Tour. Want the big show? Sunset bat tour at Waugh Bridge. Date night? Full Moon Tour, next one Oct 25. Rather go solo? Rentals from $20 an hour. Every option launches from Allen's Landing. Save this, then pick. #houstonkayak #buffalobayou #houstondatenight #buffalobayoukayak

slides.headline: Four ways to see the bayou. Pick yours.
slides.body: Daytime skyline, sunset bats, full moon, or a rental and no guide. Here's who each one is for.

slides.headline: Houston Skyline Tour
slides.body: 2 hours, all ages, guide and gear included. Downtown views, wildlife, Houston history from the water. $55 per person.

slides.headline: "Made me feel comfortable and safe"
slides.body: "Blake was very informative, he made me feel comfortable and safe, knowing it was my first time." TripAdvisor review

slides.kicker: If you want the big show
slides.headline: Sunset Skyline Bat Bridge Tour
slides.body: 2 to 3 hours, ages 7 and up. Golden hour on the skyline, then the Waugh Drive colony at dusk. $60 per person.

slides.headline: "The vortex of bats was mesmerizing"
slides.body: "...from the water." TripAdvisor review, October 2025. Bats are common at dusk, never guaranteed.

slides.headline: Full Moon Tour
slides.body: 2 hours on the bayou under a full moon, all ages, $65 per person. October's Hunter's Moon lands Oct 25.

slides.headline: Cool nights make this the season
slides.body: October and November are the bayou's sweet spot. Night paddles stop feeling like a sauna.

slides.headline: Rent and paddle your own route
slides.body: Single kayak or paddleboard $20 an hour, tandem $35. Paddle and life vest included. Head toward Waugh or stay downtown.

slides.headline: Do the membership math
slides.body: $300 a year for unlimited single, tandem or paddleboard rentals, plus priority booking.

slides.headline: Every option launches from Allen's Landing
slides.body: 1019 Commerce St, open daily. Book at buffalobayoukayak.com.
